content: {"items":[{"statement":"The British governor constructed a fort on New Providence in 1695 and named it Nassau in honor of King William III.","evidence_id":"e-9c9f83095e49bbfd3e8f","passage_ids":[7],"kind":"source_statement","source_type":"SECONDARY_SOURCE","actors":[],"places":[],"dates":["1695"],"usage_type":"ANCHORAGE","uncertainty":[]},{"statement":"Great Britain regained control and maintained it until the outbreak of the American Revolution when John Paul Jones participated in the brief American seizure of Nassau in March 1776.","evidence_id":"e-9c9f83095e49bbfd3e8f","passage_ids":[9],"kind":"source_statement","source_type":"SECONDARY_SOURCE","actors":[],"places":[],"dates":["1776"],"usage_type":"RAID_LOCATION","uncertainty":[]}]}
